_how: Pictures next to 13F managers and public officials on the site. Members of Congress get their official portrait automatically (public domain). For a fund or any other person, add an entry: managers by 13F CIK, people by the name the disclosures use (or a Congress bioguide id). image = an https URL, or the file name of a picture you put in disclosures/config/avatars/ (under 400 KB). Use only pictures you are allowed to use. Without a picture the page shows initials.
